name: pixel-pet
description: An animated pixel-art companion above your prompt that reacts to your session and your typing, with a live context meter.

name.title: Pet name
name.description: What a new pet is called; leave empty for a random name (Mochi, Pixel, Pip…). Change it any time with /pet rename.

color.title: Pet colour
color.description: Its colour: teal, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink, white, gray, black, brown, cyan, mint, lime, sky, navy, indigo, violet, lavender, magenta, rose, peach, coral, gold, lava, ghost or midnight (also /pet color <name>).
